notes: While 'miskin' is the standard word for poor, be careful with the nuance. It describes a state of lacking material wealth. In some contexts, describing a person directly as 'miskin' can sound blunt or insensitive, similar to saying 'the poor' in English. Consider 'kurang mampu' (less capable/well-off) if you want a softer, more polite way to refer to someone's economic status.
